title: Part 1 speed
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the truck's speed 2 seconds after entering the ramp as 18 m/s.

title: Part 2 length
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the minimum ramp length as 73.5 m.

title: Correct equation application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the kinematic equation v = v₀ - at for part (1) and v² = v₀² - 2ax (or equivalent) for part (2).

title: Sign convention consistency
description: Important Criteria: The student must consistently treat acceleration as negative (deceleration) in their equations or correctly handle the magnitude.

title: Unit inclusion
description: Optional Criteria: The student includes correct units (m/s and m) with their final numerical answers.

title: Alternative solution check
description: Optional Criteria: The student verifies the answer for part (2) by first calculating the stopping time (3.5 s) and using x = v₀t - ½at².

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly uses acceleration as positive, leading to a speed calculation greater than the initial speed for part (1).

title: Equation misapplication
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student uses an average velocity formula without justification for part (1) or misapplies the time (e.g., using 3.5 s instead of 2 s).
